}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== The ROG Strix GS-BE18000 is the ultimate gaming router, built for those who demand perfection. Blazing-fast speeds up to 18,000Mbps powered by cutting-edge tri-band WiFi 7 and 4x4 MIMO, plus a combined 20G wired capacity, ensure seamless, low-latency gaming across all platforms. The ROG- exclusive Gaming Network also brings groundbreaking one-tap SSID game acceleration, while Triple-Level Network Security secures and simplifies your connected world.
